recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for the core reconcile branch. Any future correction, including review of the Extension Pack preferred binding, should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions rather than by duplicating the extension definition in core.
issue_request: FHIR-17574 requested additional classification for Address beyond Address.use. Its Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution was to define a 0..1 standard extension on Address, with CodeableConcept value and preferred terminology binding, rather than adding an Address.classification element.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged application or address-classification StructureDefinition was found in the core FHIR repository. The implementation history was found in HL7/fhir-extensions: commit 54afcee5ba31dbb46312b2912ad4fd15875a9ea5, 'FHIR-17574 Add classification to Address', added input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-address-classification.json, and later extension-pack commits e4e4ee7 and 8f17aa6 refined wording and comment metadata.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini confirms core still actively publishes the Address datatype and several datatype extension spreadsheets, but the specific address-classification extension is absent from core source. Current Extension Pack source defines http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/address-classification with Address context, max 1, CodeableConcept value, and preferred binding. FHIR-I minutes confirm the 2023 disposition, and PA minutes document later discussion about value-set choice and why Location does not need the extension directly because Location.type already exists.
reconciliation: No core source file was changed. The reconciliation published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch to record that the requested artifact belongs to and has been implemented in the FHIR Extension Pack.
